name: Bryan Ford
one_sentence_summary: Bryan Ford leads DEDIS at EPFL, researching decentralized trust, scalable consensus, coercion-resistant e-voting, and privacy-preserving distributed systems, with an increasingly prominent thread on formal logic via a growing suite of Grounded Arithmetic papers formalized in Isabelle.
matrix_summary: Bryan Ford has posted three new Grounded Arithmetic preprints in October–November 2026, culminating in a 103-page machine-checked Isabelle/HOL paper proving Gödel's Incompleteness Theorems within Reflective Grounded Arithmetic (RGA). Simultaneously, the DEDIS GitHub shows a burst of activity on the matchertext injection-safety ecosystem (3 new repos) and a new mysterious `accountability_for_acs` Rust repo.
